learning_path:
**Learning Path for a Confident Public Speaker and Presenter**
====================================================================

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU5835 | Professional Selling: Step 2 - Prepare Like a High-Performer | Coursera | Develop foundational communication skills, including establishing needs and problems, strategizing, and tracking conversion ratios. |
| 2 | COU2728 | Market Research Specialization | Coursera | Build on existing communication skills by learning to analyze and interpret data, develop a research proposal, and manage research instruments. |
| 3 | COU4016 | Microsoft 365 Fundamentals Specialization | Coursera | Apply market research skills by learning to create and edit workbooks, manage presentations, and describe Microsoft 365 apps and services. |
| 4 | COU1950 | Programming Fundamentals in Kotlin | Coursera | Develop programming skills to create and manage presentations, and apply them to real-life situations. |
| 5 | COU5780 | Microsoft Azure Data Engineering Associate (DP-203) Professional Certificate | Coursera | Learn to develop Azure compute solutions, monitor and troubleshoot Azure solutions, and develop for Azure storage. |
| 6 | COU1612 | Mastering Geospatial Analysis with QGIS | Coursera | Apply data engineering skills by learning to deploy web and mobile GIS applications, skills in satellite data acquisition, classification, and temporal analysis. |
| 7 | COU5758 | Rapid Prototyping Materials and Tooling | Coursera | Develop skills in rapid prototyping, including knowledge of materials and tools used for rapid prototyping. |
| 8 | COU215 | Social Policy for Social Services & Health Practitioners Specialization | Coursera | Apply rapid prototyping skills by learning to differentiate alternative approaches to social policy problems, critique components of a social policy, and apply concepts and tools to advance energy justice. |
| 9 | COU2969 | Social Services for Families, Seniors and Those with Disabilities | Coursera | Learn to design and redesign energy systems to put justice at the center, recognizing energy injustice, and applying concepts and tools to advance energy justice. |
| 10 | COU6487 | Healthcare Organizations and the Health System | Coursera | Apply social services skills by learning to design and redesign energy systems to put justice at the center, recognizing energy injustice, and applying concepts and tools to advance energy justice. |

The learning path starts with developing foundational communication skills, including establishing needs and problems, strategizing, and tracking conversion ratios. It then builds on these skills by learning to analyze and interpret data, develop a research proposal, and manage research instruments. The path continues by applying market research skills to create and edit workbooks, manage presentations, and describe Microsoft 365 apps and services. Next, it develops programming skills to create and manage presentations, and applies them to real-life situations. The path then learns to develop Azure compute solutions, monitor and troubleshoot Azure solutions, and develop for Azure storage. It applies data engineering skills by learning to deploy web and mobile GIS applications, skills in satellite data acquisition, classification, and temporal analysis. The path continues by developing skills in rapid prototyping, including knowledge of materials and tools used for rapid prototyping. It applies rapid prototyping skills by learning to differentiate alternative approaches to social policy problems, critique components of a social policy, and apply concepts and tools to advance energy justice. Finally, it learns to design and redesign energy systems to put justice at the center, recognizing energy injustice, and applying concepts and tools to advance energy justice.

This learning path provides a comprehensive foundation in sustainability, environmental policy, and corporate responsibility, progressing from foundational to advanced courses. The path begins with EDX1173, introducing sustainability concepts and environmental policy frameworks. EDX3225 and EDX3340 build on this knowledge, developing skills in business sustainability management and corporate sustainability management. EDX3254 and EDX3418 focus on sustainability leadership and high-impact leadership, respectively. EDX3299 introduces technology and management aspects of sustainability strategy, while EDX2078 develops skills in corporate sustainability, social innovation, and ethics. The path continues with EDX3436, focusing on sustainable fashion and brand strategy, and EDX875, emphasizing responsible innovation and stakeholder engagement. EDX3435 and EDX2960 develop skills in compliance management and data storytelling, respectively. | 1 | EDX1549 | SQL for Data Science | edx | Foundational SQL skills are essential for data engineering. This course provides a solid introduction to SQL and its applications in data science. |

| 3 | EDX3179 | Preparing for the Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer Exam | edx | This course prepares the learner for the Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer exam, which covers advanced data engineering topics. |
| 4 | EDX2429 | MLOps1 (AWS): Deploying AI & ML Models in Production using Amazon Web Services | edx | This course covers machine learning operations (MLOps) and deploying AI and ML models in production using AWS. |
| 5 | EDX1636 | Big Data Computing with Spark | edx | This course provides in-depth knowledge of Apache Spark and its applications in big data computing. |
| 6 | EDX2758 | Guided Project: Get Started with IBM Db2 on Cloud | edx | This course provides hands-on experience with IBM Db2 on Cloud and data engineering concepts. |
| 7 | EDX719 | Querying Data with Transact-SQL | edx | This course covers advanced SQL skills, including querying data with Transact-SQL. |
| 8 | EDX1867 | Data Warehousing and BI Analytics | edx | This course covers data warehousing and business intelligence analytics, including designing and populating a data warehouse. |
| 9 | EDX1689 | MLOps2 (Azure): Data Pipeline Automation & Optimization using Microsoft Azure Machine Learning | edx | This course covers MLOps and data pipeline automation using Azure Machine Learning. |
| 10 | EDX1651 | MLOps2 (GCP): Data Pipeline Automation & Optimization using Google Cloud Platform | edx | This course covers MLOps and data pipeline automation using Google Cloud Platform. |

The learning path starts with foundational SQL skills in Period 1, followed by hands-on experience with data engineering concepts in Period 2. Period 3 prepares the learner for the Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer exam, which covers advanced data engineering topics. Periods 4-6 cover MLOps, big data computing with Spark, and data engineering with IBM Db2 on Cloud. Periods 7-8 cover advanced SQL skills and data warehousing and business intelligence analytics. Finally, Periods 9-10 cover MLOps and data pipeline automation using Azure and Google Cloud Platform.

The learning path fits together by building on existing skills, gradually increasing the complexity and depth of topics, and emphasizing practical application and problem-solving skills. The path covers a range of topics, from foundational SQL skills to advanced data engineering and MLOps concepts, and provides hands-on experience with various tools and technologies.

**Learning Path for Supply Chain and Operations Management in Manufacturing**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1-2 | EDX2327 | Operations Management | edx | Foundational knowledge of operations management, including supply chain structure and inventory management. |
| 3-4 | EDX210 | Supply Chain Comprehensive Exam | edx | Assessment of supply chain knowledge and skills, with a focus on logistics and transportation. |
| 5-6 | EDX3338 | Operations Management | edx | In-depth understanding of operations management, including lean thinking and business operation risk. |
| 7-8 | EDX2883 | Supply Chain Planning and Strategy | edx | Development of supply chain planning and strategy skills, including global supply chain cross-functional and logistic drivers. |
| 9-10 | EDX1563 | Procurement and Logistics Management | edx | Understanding of procurement and logistics management, including inventory management and material requirements planning. |
| 11-12 | EDX1505 | Supply Chains for Manufacturing: Inventory Analytics | edx | Application of inventory analytics and process improvement techniques in supply chain management. |
| 13-14 | EDX1087 | Purchase management | edx | Development of purchase management skills, including sales planning and market segmentation. |
| 15-16 | EDX3219 | Supply Chain Management | edx | In-depth understanding of supply chain management, including warehouse performance and reverse logistics. |
| 17-18 | EDX1089 | Supply Chain Management Tools and Techniques | edx | Application of supply chain management tools and techniques, including aggregate planning and lean and continuous improvement. |
| 19-20 | EDX901 | Supply Chain Design | edx | Development of supply chain design skills, including identification of operations systems and assessment of complexity. |
| 21-22 | EDX2548 | Introduction to Lean Six Sigma for Sustainable and Resilient Supply Chains | edx | Understanding of lean six sigma principles and their application in supply chain management. |
| 23-24 | EDX167 | System Design for Supply Chain Management and Logistics | edx | In-depth understanding of system design for supply chain management and logistics, including sustainability and supply chain strategy. |
| 25-26 | EDX2802 | Master Control in Supply Chain Management and Logistics | edx | Development of master control skills in supply chain management and logistics, including transportation and packaging. |
| 27-28 | EDX2144 | Supply Chains for Manufacturing: Capacity Analytics | edx | Application of capacity analytics and process improvement techniques in supply chain management. |
| 29-30 | EDX1374 | Supply Chain Design | edx | In-depth understanding of supply chain design, including network design and facility location. |
| 31-32 | EDX1885 | Manufacturing Systems II | edx | Understanding of manufacturing systems and their application in supply chain management. |
| 33-34 | EDX395 | ISCEA Certified Supply Chain Analyst (CSCA) Exam | edx | Assessment of supply chain knowledge and skills, with a focus on supply chain analysis and business & management. |
| 35-36 | EDX593 | Lean Six Sigma Program and Project Management | edx | Development of lean six sigma program and project management skills, including problem-solving and metrics. |
| 37-38 | EDX2965 | Supply Chain Technology and Systems | edx | Understanding of supply chain technology and systems, including data analysis and business intelligence. |
| 39-40 | EDX2017 | Inventory and Portfolio Management | edx | In-depth understanding of inventory and portfolio management, including sales and manufacturing processes. |
| 41-42 | EDX3306 | Sales Management Program | edx | Development of sales management skills, including team performance management and performance management. |
| 43-44 | EDX3213 | Strategies for Supply Chain Digitalization | edx | Understanding of strategies for supply chain digitalization, including digital logistics and supply chain optimization. |
| 45-46 | EDX2956 | Management in Engineering: Accounting and Planning | edx | In-depth understanding of management in engineering, including financial statements and financial management. |
| 47-48 | EDX1670 | Supply Chain Dynamics | edx | Application of supply chain dynamics and process improvement techniques in supply chain management. |
| 49-50 | EDX3401 | Sustainable Supply Chain Management | edx | Development of sustainable supply chain management skills, including innovation and customer service. |

This learning path provides a comprehensive foundation in public policy analysis and governance, progressing from foundational knowledge to advanced skills in data analysis, policy evaluation, and critical thinking. The next course introduces social policy and its application in health and social services, while the fourth course develops data analysis skills for policy-making. The advanced courses in data analytics and policy analysis provide practical skills for public sector applications, and the final course on corruption and its impact on governance and policy-making encourages critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

**How the path fits together**

This learning path is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of project management and agile delivery. The path starts with foundational knowledge of project management, including the project life cycle, stakeholders, and basic project management concepts. It then progresses to advanced project management concepts and techniques, including strategic thinking and planning for projects. The path also covers agile project management, including agile methodologies and leadership principles. Additionally, the path includes courses on programme management, monitoring and evaluation, and effective communication for stakeholders and teams. The path culminates in a deep dive into agile delivery, building on the foundational knowledge and practical application learned earlier. The path also includes courses on data analysis and visualization, business analytics, and digital marketing analytics. The path is designed to be flexible and adaptable, allowing learners to adjust the pace and content to suit their needs.
